==Records and statistics==
{{Updated|[[2023 CONCACAF Champions League]]|<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesc/cacupsalltime.html |title=CONCACAF Club Cups All-Time Tables |website=[[RSSSF]] |accessdate=11 September 2021}}</ref>}}
In this ranking [[Three points for a win|3 points are awarded for a win]], 1 for a draw and 0 for a loss. As per statistical convention in football, matches decided in [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] are counted as wins and losses, while matches decided by [[penalty shootout (association football)|penalty shoot-outs]] are counted as draws. Teams are ranked by total points, then by goal difference, then by goals scored.{{Citation needed|date=September 2021}}
